_about: Which standards apply to which document kinds, by the standard's ROLE (owner order 3 Nov 2026, 'choose the rulebook by document kind'). Owner-editable data: nothing in code names a standard or a kind. A standard whose role is not listed for the document's kind is LEFT OUT of that review and counted in the run note; a standard with no role here, a kind with no entry, a manual choice by an engineer and an undecided or guessed kind are never left out (a kind only narrows). Switch: STANDARD_ROLES_BY_KIND_ENABLED, off by default.

roles.equipment design: Says how a piece of equipment or an instrument is designed, built or protected (design sections, fireproofing). It does not say how a study or a procedure is run.
roles.process/method: Says how work or a study must be done (how a HAZOP or SIL study is run, how a procedure is written).
